NEWARK, N.J. — Two additional arrests were made July 2 in the significant drug trafficking case we recently reported on involving charges for 24 defendants.

Our trafficking ring investigation resulted in charges for members of a Bloods-affiliated street gang.

Charges include:

📌Possessing a MACHINE GUN

📌Firearm & ammo possession by a felon

📌Trafficking FENTANYL, HEROIN & COCAINE

The defendants are all members or associates of Sex, Money, Murder — a Bloods-affiliated criminal street gang that controls the drug trade in and around the Bradley Court Housing Complex in Newark.

As reported earlier, the recovered machine gun was used in a June 17 shooting.

We were honored to be a part of an incredible law enforcement partnership that helped dismantle this crime ring.

🔎To learn more, read the press release from ICE HSI Newark below. ⬇️
